pages.text: $(bold)Chishi Catalyst$(): consumes Chishi Energy to $(bold)boost$() crystal cluster growth on Geodes in range. Each tick, after paying energy, it performs one growth attempt on every Geode in range (stacking with the Geode's natural random tick); success chance depends on the tier.

$(bold)Tier values:$(br)$(li)Basic: 3x3x3 range, 20% chance, 5 E/t$(li)Medium: 5x5x5 range, 30% chance, 25 E/t$(li)Advanced: 9x9x9 range, 40% chance, 125 E/t$(li)Ultimate: 16x16x16 range, 50% chance, 625 E/t$(br)$(bold)Note:$() Pauses when energy runs out. Pair with an Auto Collector: the catalyst grows, the collector harvests.
